prompted_for: Specimen sheet of 9 equipment vignettes (pretreatment, RO skid, EDI, still, pure steam generator, tank, pump, heat exchanger, UV and ozone); cut into Spot masks in assets/spots/
composition: 3 x 3 grid of isolated equipment drawings
each object floats with no ground or frame
consistent isometric angle and similar scale
rendering: technical illustration as in equipment manuals
outline only with interior detail lines
line_and_texture: fine secondary detail lines on flanges, bolts and plate packs
motion_implied: spot fades and lifts in on scroll
t2i_keywords: fine detail lines on flanges and bolts
t2i_prompt: Specimen sheet of isolated isometric technical line drawings on a pure white background, arranged in a 3 by 3 grid with wide gutters and no labels. Each vignette shows one piece of industrial equipment: <CONTENT>. Black ink, uniform 1.5 px outline strokes with finer detail lines on flanges, bolts and fittings, no shading, no fills, no colour. Consistent isometric angle and scale across all objects, like illustrations in an equipment manual. Clean, precise, cut-out ready.
signature_idea: A family of manual-grade isometric equipment drawings that can be masked into any colour as spot art.
strengths: consistent angle and scale make a true family
monochrome line converts cleanly to masks in navy or steel-blue
no text to fight with the page
weaknesses: several subjects are stainless/off-offer for a PP PW maker (still, pure steam generator)
black on white is not the brand palette until recoloured
fine detail may break at small sizes
generic catalogue look without brand colour
brand_fit_why: Precise, calm, square line art suits the brand once masked into navy/steel-blue; raw black-on-white and off-offer equipment keep it from a 5.
